analysis.pricePatternEn: Higher Low pattern confirmed, signaling recovery
analysis.reason: RSI 42.5에서 61.9로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 -0.2175에서 5.9690으로 개선되며 상승 추세 강화. 5일 저가($496.81)가 20일 저가($489.21) 대비 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성. SMA20($518.40) 및 SMA50($525.05) 상향 돌파 후 지지력 확인 구간.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 42.5 to 61.9, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -0.2175 to 5.9690, strengthening the uptrend. The 5-day low ($496.81) is higher than the 20-day low ($489.21), forming a Higher Low pattern. Currently in a consolidation phase after breaking above SMA20 ($518.40) and SMA50 ($525.05) and testing them as support.
